_comment: Black Friday 2026 workshops (Kalleigh 23 Nov, Vagisha 24 Nov). Source for /black-friday/ and the Worker's offer prices (written into worker/prices.json by the build). Times are Ontario wall clock. 'half' means the price is exactly half the course's regular catalogue price; the build refuses the page if that stops being true. Microdermabrasion is the microdermabrasion workshop only, without the facial (Jules, 25 Nov), so it makes no 50% claim, and the full course's kit is not offered with it. The Monday workshops moved to the Tuesday after (Kalleigh, 25 Nov: Dec 7 becomes Dec 8, Dec 14 becomes Dec 15).
